name: Categories (Menu only)
xml:
<field
	type="ModalSelect"
	name="category_request_id"
	label="Category"
	sql_title_table="#__###component###_category"
	sql_title_column="name"
	sql_title_key="id"
	urlSelect="index.php?option=com_###component###&view=categories&layout=modal&tmpl=component&titleKey=id"
	urlNew="index.php?option=com_###component###&task=category.add&layout=modal&tmpl=component"
	urlEdit="index.php?option=com_###component###&task=category.edit&id={id}&layout=modal&tmpl=component&titleKey=id"
	titleSelect="Select a Category"
	titleNew="New Category"
	titleEdit="Edit Category"
	iconSelect="icon-copy"
	select="true"
	new="true"
	edit="true"
	clear="true"
	required="true"
	class="input-large"
	description="Choose the category that best fits your company’s industry or services."
	hint="Select a Category"
	display="menu"
/>
